openwrt_git.commit_message:
mediatek: filogic: add support for WAVLINK WL-WN573HX3

The WL-WN573HX3 is an AX3000 outdoor Access Point by WAVLINK,
also sold in Europe as 7Links WLR-1300 (ZX-5612).

Specifications:

- MT7981B + MT7976 AX3000 2x2 DBDC (160 MHz)
- 16 MiB SPI NOR, 256 MiB RAM
- Gigabit ethernet port, 802.3af PoE
- IP67 outdoor case for wall or pole mounting with
    four single band RP-SMA fiberglass antennas (8 dBi)

Installation:

- OEM Web UI is at 192.168.30.1 which will forward to
    http://netlogin.link (using a captive portal)
- login with default password `admin`
- skip setup wizard by navigating directly to
    http://netlogin.link/html/meshUpgrade.html
- upload WN573HX3-sysupgrade.bin
- reset to factory defaults to discard OEM UCI settings

MAC address assignment:

LAN         80:xx:xx:76:xx:25  hw 0x44e
WLAN 2.4G   80:xx:xx:76:xx:27  factory 0x04 (label MAC)
WLAN 5G	    82:xx:xx:46:xx:27
pair key    8a:xx:xx:76:xx:27  also on label, not used by OpenWrt

Signed-off-by: Sebastian Schaper <openwrt@sebastianschaper.net>

openwrt_dts.ethernet: gmac1, gmii, interner GbE-PHY (int_gbe_phy), MAC aus hw 0x44e
openwrt_dts.flash: SPI-NOR an spi2, jedec,spi-nor, 52 MHz, Quad

openwrt_pr_18206.spezifikation: MT7981B + MT7976 AX3000 2x2 DBDC (160 MHz); 16 MiB SPI NOR, 256 MiB RAM; Gigabit ethernet port, 802.3af PoE; IP67 outdoor case for wall or pole mounting with four single band RP-SMA fiberglass antennas (8 dBi)
openwrt_pr_18206.zitat_label: the full human-readable model name given in the .dts should read 7Links here, since the WN573HX3 model name is not visible anywhere on the device label or packaging
openwrt_pr_18206.zitat_hardware: The hardware of this device seems to be quite identical to the WL-WN573HX3 available directly from china. ... I do not own the chinese model (there might indeed be further differences e.g. in the eeprom partition due to the different regdomain), however the Wavlink firmware was accepted by the updater of the 7Links-branded device
openwrt_pr_18206.zitat_gluon: a major use case for this access point would be as an outdoor node for gluon
openwrt_pr_18206.dateiname: The string WN573HX3 needs to be present within the uploaded filename to be accepted by the OEM web-based updater.
openwrt_pr_18206.mac: LAN 80:xx:xx:76:xx:25 hw 0x44e; WLAN 2.4G 80:xx:xx:76:xx:27 factory 0x04 (label MAC); WLAN 5G 82:xx:xx:46:xx:27; pair key 8a:xx:xx:76:xx:27 also on label, not used by OpenWrt
openwrt_pr_18206.oem_sysupgrade: OEM firmware uses sysupgrade without the option to discard current UCI settings; factory reset after flashing

gluon_pr_3510.checkliste: Web-Interface-Flash ja, TFTP nein; sysupgrade ja; Reset-Knopf -> Config-Mode ja; Primär-MAC = Label ja; alle Ports, korrekte Zuordnung; AP/Mesh/AP+Mesh auf allen Radios; Status-LED + Config-Mode-Blinken; Port-LED Link/Aktivität; is_outdoor_device ergänzt; supported_devices.rst ergänzt
gluon_pr_3510.bemerkung: Auch als 7Links WLR-1300 (Pearl ZX-5612). Gluon braucht kein Verwerfen der OEM-UCI-Konfiguration (Skript 900-discard-oem-config wieder entfernt)
